body.name: Inherited total exhaustive procedure compiler
body.construction: Given \(G\), first test whether \(d_n^2+1<n\). If this test fails, immediately return the degenerate assignment law concentrated on \(\boldsymbol{1}_n\) and the estimator \(T(G,Z,Y,U)=n^{-1}\sum_{i\in V_n}Y_i\). No seed-side quantity is evaluated on this branch. Only if \(d_n^2+1<n\), compute \(B_G\), all \(m_i(G)\), and \(k_{n,d_n}\); enumerate all \(n^{k_{n,d_n}}\) ordered seed tuples; group them by the induced assignment; and compute every \(w_i(z;G)\) and the exact worst-case quadratic risk certificate of \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}\). On this branch, return the seed law and estimator when that certificate is at most one, and otherwise return the same all-treated law and estimator.
